record.file_problem: The full text is present. No apparent truncation or text corruption.
record.tranche_reason: The study reports its own measurements linking persistent homology to the train–test accuracy gap, a different measure from the magnitude-aware sharpness named in V7. It does not test V7’s specific sharpness measure or the other listed versions.
record.gate_note: The study reports results for homotopy classes and persistence versus generalization. The transfer results and optimizer comparison examples do not test the listed claim versions. No random-label fitting, magnitude-aware weight-perturbation sharpness, or sharpness comparison is reported.
record.test_reason: Section 11.2 reports that larger batches accompany better generalization in CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 runs trained for 200 epochs. This bears on V5, although other recipe choices vary and no workload-dependent batch threshold is established. Persistence and homotopy measurements do not test V7.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately summarizes the authors' homotopy and persistence conclusions. These are reported associations; the text does not establish magnitude-aware sharpness or an isolated causal effect of batch size.
record.recipe_differences: Measures persistence and homotopy classes rather than the random-label memorization, width, architecture, optimizer, batch-size, dropout, sharpness, or memorized-example interventions in the listed versions.
record.method_sensitivity: The CIFAR-10 persistence study varies learning rate, batch size, weight decay and data augmentation; the text reports larger batches associated with higher persistence and better generalization, without separating batch-size-specific gap values.

fits_no_version.finding: Reported persistence is negatively associated with the train–test accuracy gap, with R² = 0.82.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Total persistence tracks the generalization gap across the tested CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 runs.

fits_no_version.finding: MNIST test accuracies reportedly vary less within detected homotopy classes than between classes.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The study's trajectory grouping predicts similarity of test accuracy.

record.problems: The persistence result is reported as a fitted correlation without uncertainty estimates or a stated control comparison. The text gives no per-network data. The homotopy-class results are aggregates and do not report a direct train–test gap by class.
record.rows_left_out: No other claim-version results were reported. The ImageNet-to-fine-grained transfer comparison and natural-gradient example concern transfer efficiency and training speed/accuracy, respectively, not the listed versions.

untested.parts: Random-label fitting and natural-label versus random-label held-out performance.
Width sweeps beyond zero training error.
Convolutional versus fully connected architectures and local connectivity.
Controlled adaptive-optimizer versus SGD comparisons under specified tuning budgets; introductory examples do not provide such a comparison.
Batch-specific held-out results, the workload-dependent threshold, isolated batch-size effects, longer training, and controlled recipe adaptations.
Magnitude-aware perturbation sharpness, similarly low training loss, and comparisons against norm- and margin-based measures.
Removing memorized examples and retraining against random-removal controls.

missing.what: A qualitative batch-size result: larger batches accompany higher persistence and better generalization. Record the batch range and 200-epoch budget, and explicitly note that batch-specific accuracies and controls for other varying hyperparameters are unavailable.
missing.locator: §11.2, Setup, Methodology and final Results bullet

record.verdict_notes: The existing rows cannot determine effects for the listed versions, despite accurately recording most source values. The persistence implementation in §10.3 computes homology from Euclidean perturbation samples without using the calculated loss values, further complicating its interpretation as loss-landscape persistence.

versions.untested_parts: No random-label training or comparison of natural-label and random-label test performance.
No network-width sweep beyond the interpolation threshold.
No convolutional versus fully connected comparison.
No adaptive optimizer versus SGD generalization comparison.
No controlled large-batch versus small-batch comparison holding epoch budget fixed.
Persistence is measured, but magnitude-aware sharpness and the version’s comparison against norm- and margin-based measures are not tested.
No removal and retraining of memorized examples.
